audit_scope.exact_materialization_statement: exact materialization not found in bounded current audit

entities.name: SCAF / Spatiotemporal Causal Affordance Fabric
entities.target_question: Does Object/World Properties x Environment x Agent Constraints x Desired Future State require a new reusable primitive for affordance/possibility without collapsing possibility into intent or authority?
observed_coverage: Core already owns State/Evidence -> Possibility/Availability -> Intent separation
Capability selection and fresh execution capability availability already have reusable pre-authorization interfaces
Counterfactual intervention already provides bounded model-relative intervention semantics
entities.observed_gap: No current provider-neutral physical/world causal-property evidence interface is established; the current counterfactual model is explicitly bounded to an exact local Git transition and is not a physical-world model.
entities.architecture_interpretation: If future world/physical evidence is integrated, project it into existing State/Availability/Capability interfaces rather than create a second Possibility/Availability primitive.

entities.name: CPOT / Continuity-Preserving Ordinal Transition
entities.target_question: Does a rule/model transition need a new primitive to preserve predecessor evidence, historical statuses/expectations, uncertainty and an event-specific successor?
observed_coverage: Core already has exact predecessor/successor frontier semantics
ResponsibilityEventChain makes non-retroactive historical assurance machine-verifiable
Future Optionality preserves superseded/abandoned predecessor provenance without making a successor mandatory
Current roadmap preserves No Silent Reinterpretation as an invariant
entities.observed_gap: A reusable transition policy could name dual evaluation, translation and continuity gates across rule/model regimes, but current evidence does not show a missing state/successor primitive.
entities.architecture_interpretation: Treat CPOT as a transition policy/profile over existing provenance, successor and non-reinterpretation machinery unless an independent transition domain proves a missing primitive.

entities.name: Immune Tremor
entities.target_question: Does a minimal bounded reversible diagnostic perturbation for a causally ambiguous or suspected-stalled process require a distinct reusable primitive?
observed_coverage: FCL already distinguishes RUNNING, SUSPECTED_STALL and terminal closure
Event-Responsive Dormancy already provides wake attention and current evidence/authority/intent re-evaluation without authority restoration
Existing bounded action interfaces separately govern any action and post-action observation
entities.observed_gap: A future policy may constrain diagnostic perturbation minimality/reversibility, but no evidence requires a self-authorizing wake/probe primitive.
entities.architecture_interpretation: Compose FCL stall evidence with separately admitted bounded diagnostic action and successor observation; do not let the perturbation authorize itself or become polling.

entities.name: Conscious AI (operational conscious agency only)
entities.target_question: Does bounded situational modelling, role/limit awareness, alternative successor representation, question/attention/re-entry candidates, admissible action selection, bounded explanation and outcome update require a new primitive?
observed_coverage: Core already separates state, possibility, intent, authority, action and successor
Capability selection/availability provide bounded option handling before authorization
Counterfactual intervention represents alternative scenarios without causal overclaim
FCL preserves ongoing causal continuity and successor continuation
Non-Binding Attention demonstrates a bounded attention policy in one pilot without Core promotion
entities.observed_gap: A generic self-generated question/attention/re-entry interface is not established by current reusable evidence; the existing attention implementation is pilot-specific.
entities.architecture_interpretation: Use Conscious AI only as an operational conformance/assessment profile over existing primitives; keep generic self-generated re-entry as an explicit unresolved sub-gap pending independent reusable demand.
